candidates.classification_evidence: Item description: 'Footage from a "Midnight Madness" launch of Windows 95 at a CompUSA store. Recorded on 8/23/95.' In-page frames show SD camcorder image, period Windows 95 launch retail materials, a camcorder time overlay on the exterior shot; no modern devices seen in sampled frames.
candidates.duration_seconds_source: ffprobe on the acquired file (item page and IA metadata said 230.62)

active_picture.note: 4:3 picture pillarboxed inside the 854x480 container; ffmpeg cropdetect

candidates.fps_note: confirmed by ffprobe on the acquired file: r_frame_rate 30000/1001; h264 Main; opus stereo audio present
candidates.out_point_note: CHECKED ON THE ACQUIRED ORIGINAL: the scouted out point 00:02:24.0 does not hold. The aisle walk runs about 02:16.3-02:20; at 02:21 the man turns back to camera; 02:22-02:22.5 is a medium of a CompUSA employee at the 'New For Windows 95' pyramid; by 02:23 a two-man interaction has begun and 02:24 is mid-handshake. Recommended out 00:02:22.5 (6.5 s, under the ticket's preferred 8-12 s). The in point 00:02:16.0 holds but is soft; about 00:02:16.3 is cleaner. See qa.md Part 2.

alternate_segment.note: crowded aisle then pan over boxed-software rack under 'Games' sign

candidates.visual_fit: Handheld follow of a man walking an aisle of shelved yellow boxed software under a 'New For Windows 95' end-cap and CompUSA wall sign; turns toward shelf as a costumed promoter points at boxes. Genuine mid-90s big-box software retail. Event night: balloons, crowd, costumed promoter.

'Make a fast transition to Windows 95!' sign
defects: 4:3 picture pillarboxed in 16:9 frame (as seen in player)
